Team Categories

Your team’s category is determined by the younger member of the team.

Age is calculated as per 31 December the year the race takes place.

Teams who wish to compete for prize money must register in the Racing category. These teams will no longer qualify for their age group leader jersey and age group ranking.

2025 E-bike Rules

Team Categories

Teams in the UCI categories will not qualify for age group leader jerseys in Mixed, Amateur, Masters, Grand Masters, and Great Grand Masters categories. Team age group will be determined by the age of the youngest rider in your team.

Whale Category

This special category is reserved for those living on the larger side of life. Teams that consist of riders both over 90 kilograms can register as Whales and qualify for recognition that often comes in the form of bottles of wine from the award-winning farms along our route.

Rider Service

Entry Cancellation

Should you wish to cancel your entry, please note the following and contact the Race Office at [email protected] to have the cancellation processed.

  • 75% of the entry fee is refundable if the cancellation is done before 30 July 2026.
  • 50% of the entry fee is refundable if the cancellation is done in August 2026.
  • 0% of the entry fee is refundable if the cancellation is done in September and October 2026.
  • If at a later stage your partner can no longer participate once substitutions have closed, you will be allowed to do a late substitution at Registration Day.
  • Entries are not transferable to the following year.

Optional Extra Cancellation

Should you wish to cancel any of your optional extras, a 15% admin/cancellation fee will apply. Please contact the Race Office at [email protected] to have the cancellation processed.

Optional extras are not transferable to the following year.

Entries can be transferred, sold or given to another person with prior permission from the event organisers.


Online substitutions close on 30 October 2026. Hereafter, late substitutions must be done at Registration day. 

 

Though substitutions can be actioned at registration we kindly request that all substitution requests be submitted before Registration Day. This will help avoid long waiting times, queues, and potential delays during registration

 

The following fees apply for substitutions:

  • R650 for requests received before 30 September 
  • R750 for requests received on or after 1 October.

 

Substitution form: 2026 Wines2Whales - Withdrawal, Rider Substitution & Team Change Form | za.epic-series.com

 

Once the completed form has been received, please allow up to 7 days for the substitution to be processed. 


Please note:

  • Riders who have entered and paid, but cannot participate in the FNB W2W Event, for whatever reason, must inform the Race Office.
  • No rider is allowed to participate under the name of another participant. Such action will lead to immediate disqualification.
  • Substituted team participants will receive the clothing size of the initial participant, unless this is changed before 15 May 2026.

All riders must accept an online liability disclaimer upon registering their team for an event. Failure to accept the liability disclaimer will result in the rider not being allowed to start the race.
